name: roommix
description: Real-time audio mixing service for face-to-face translation: core library, WebSocket server, browser simulator.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:server: gcloud builds submit --config advanced/deploy/cloudbuild.yaml --project f2f-audio-mixer --region europe-west1 . && gcloud run deploy roommix --image europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/f2f-audio-mixer/cloud-run-source-deploy/roommix:latest --project f2f-audio-mixer --region europe-west1 --allow-unauthenticated --port 8080 --memory 512Mi --max-instances 1 --session-affinity --timeout 3600 --quiet
scripts.release:web: VITE_WS_URL="wss://$(gcloud run services describe roommix --project f2f-audio-mixer --region europe-west1 --format 'value(status.url)' | sed 's#^https://##')/ws" pnpm --filter @roommix/simulator build && rm -rf advanced/deploy/public && cp -R simulator/dist advanced/deploy/public && firebase deploy --only hosting --project f2f-audio-mixer --config advanced/deploy/firebase.json
